transcript.text: Bosch SMS25AW00G, came back to E:09 on the display and the dishes are washed but stone cold. Is this an expensive fix?

I have noted the E:09 code on your Bosch dishwasher display. This is a controller report and does not prove a part has failed, so we will proceed with this next step regardless. Please remember that Eco and Quick programmes are designed to run at lower temperatures to save energy, which also means they dry less effectively than standard cycles. Which programme do you normally use — eco or quick, or a normal / intensive one?
Mostly the normal programme, but I tried a hot one too and that was cold as well. So it's not just eco. Any idea what it might cost to fix?

Thanks for letting us know about the issue with your Bosch dishwasher staying cold during normal or intensive cycles. One more thing that helps clarify the situation is checking the cycle duration and progress. Does the programme take much longer than usual, or seem to get stuck part way through?
Yes, the cycle runs very long or sometimes just stops. It's been like that the last three runs. Still wondering about the cost though, it's 9 years old so I'm weighing up repair vs replace.

[Heading: Heater]
Thanks for letting me know it’s taking much longer than usual. Based on what you’ve described, the heater (heater pump or element) is the most likely cause, though it would need testing to be certain. I can’t match a suitable replacement for your model from here, so an appliance engineer is the best next step.
